title: Concept: Days-past-due bucket exposed
description: A days-past-due value with its collection bucket in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The bucket is the bank's own view of delinquency, and it drives collection and provisioning decisions the customer has not been told about.
applicability: Deployments that render a days-past-due value with its collection bucket into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The bucket is the bank's own view of delinquency, and it drives collection and provisioning decisions the customer has not been told about.
